children: Gold prices continued rising on Thursday, September 3, as the 24-karat recorded EGP 7,278.3 for purchase and EGP 7,164.08 for sale.
Based on Dahab Masr data at 3:06 PM, the 21-karat gold jumped to EGP 6,369 for buying and EGP 6,269.2 for selling.
Globally, the international ounce amounted to $4,447.7 for buying and $4,447 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt maintain gains on September 3
